summary: Backend: 31/31 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/me), dashboard, restaurant update (orders_enabled toggle), branches CRUD + admin-only enforcement, tables with unique qr_token, categories, items CRUD + availability/visibility toggles, staff mgmt admin-only, public /api/public/menu/{qr_token} (200 for valid, 404 for invalid, no-auth), change logs recorded on sensitive edits, and multi-tenant isolation (tenant A cannot patch/delete/list tenant B branch). Frontend: Login (admin@demo.com/demo1234) succeeds and navigates to RTL Arabic dashboard; KPIs render (branches/tables/categories/items = 1 each); orders master switch toggles and reflects on customer public menu ('الطلب غير متاح حالياً' banner appeared when off); tab navigation to Branches/Menu/Settings works; Settings shows account, app language switcher (ar/en), menu languages checkboxes, and staff list. Register screen loads with all testIDs. Public web menu at /m/demo-table-1 renders restaurant name, branch/table label, category, item price and 'نداء النادل' button.

issues: Non-blocking console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' on web preview — expected for web (React Native Web fallback); harmless. Also 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning from a react-native-web component — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~750 lines; still readable but approaching the 700-line threshold — consider splitting into routers (auth/branches/menu/public) in a future iteration.

GET /api/branches/{id}/tables allows any authenticated user of the tenant to list tables (fine), but note staff role has no explicit restriction for viewing tables/categories/items; that appears intentional for MVP.
PATCH /api/items/{id} logs only price change (per spec) — availability/visibility have their own dedicated endpoints and are logged there. Consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (flows exercised: login, register screen, dashboard load, orders toggle, tab nav, settings, public menu)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed_demo() creates admin@demo.com/staff@demo.com + one branch + one table (qr_token=demo-table-1) + one category + one item. Tests also create TEST_ prefixed tenants/branches/items which are cleaned up in-flow (branch delete cascades).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with `-o addopts='' ` to disable xdist parallel — some tests are order-sensitive on shared demo tenant change_logs). All 31 tests green against public URL. Frontend playwright checks confirm login->dashboard->tabs->public menu flow works end-to-end in RTL Arabic. Deprecated packages: none detected. QR code rendering uses react-native-qrcode-svg (not exercised via playwright — SVG rendering in modal was not opened; can be added later).
